INVALID_PRODUCT_DECISION.en-US: Invalid decision confirmation. Refresh the project and select Accept or Defer again.
INVALID_PRODUCT_DECISION.zh-CN: 决定确认参数无效，请刷新项目后重新选择接受或暂缓。

PRODUCT_DECISION_CHANGED.en-US: This decision changed after you viewed it. Review its latest content before confirming.
PRODUCT_DECISION_CHANGED.zh-CN: 该决定在查看后发生了变化，请先核对最新内容再确认。

PRODUCT_DECISION_NOT_FOUND.en-US: This decision is no longer in the current project. Refresh the project view.
PRODUCT_DECISION_NOT_FOUND.zh-CN: 当前项目中已找不到该决定，请刷新项目视图。

INVALID_PRODUCT_RELAY.en-US: Invalid stage transition. Refresh and confirm your choice again.
INVALID_PRODUCT_RELAY.zh-CN: 阶段接力参数无效，请刷新后重新确认。

INVALID_PRODUCT_RESTART.en-US: Invalid restart request. Refresh the workflow and try again.
INVALID_PRODUCT_RESTART.zh-CN: 重新运行请求无效，请刷新工作流后重试。

INVALID_PRODUCT_STAGE.en-US: Choose one of the seven product stages.
INVALID_PRODUCT_STAGE.zh-CN: 请选择七个产品阶段中的一个。

PRODUCT_RELAY_UNSUPPORTED.en-US: This workflow does not support product stage transitions.
PRODUCT_RELAY_UNSUPPORTED.zh-CN: 当前工作流不支持产品阶段接力。

PRODUCT_STAGE_NOT_READY.en-US: Complete the current stage before continuing, or open the successor already created.
PRODUCT_STAGE_NOT_READY.zh-CN: 请先完成当前阶段，或打开已经创建的后续阶段。

PRODUCT_RISK_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.en-US: Accept or explicitly defer the pending high-risk decisions before entering another stage.
PRODUCT_RISK_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.zh-CN: 进入下一阶段前，请先明确接受或暂缓待处理的高风险决定。

PRODUCT_STAGE_NOT_RECOMMENDED.en-US: This is not a recommended next stage. Confirm it as a stage switch instead.
PRODUCT_STAGE_NOT_RECOMMENDED.zh-CN: 该阶段不在推荐后续阶段中，请明确选择切换阶段。

PRODUCT_APPROVAL_NOT_FOUND.en-US: The latest user confirmation could not be verified. Confirm the stage again.
PRODUCT_APPROVAL_NOT_FOUND.zh-CN: 未能核验当前用户确认，请重新确认要进入的阶段。

PRODUCT_RELAY_REVISION_UNSUPPORTED.en-US: The published workflow does not support stage transitions. Update the product workflow first.
PRODUCT_RELAY_REVISION_UNSUPPORTED.zh-CN: 当前发布的工作流不支持阶段接力，请先更新产品工作流。

PRODUCT_RESTART_UNSUPPORTED.en-US: Only product delivery workflows can be restarted on their latest version.
PRODUCT_RESTART_UNSUPPORTED.zh-CN: 仅产品交付工作流支持升级到最新版本后重新运行。

PRODUCT_RESTART_NOT_ALLOWED.en-US: Only an undismissed failed product workflow can be restarted.
PRODUCT_RESTART_NOT_ALLOWED.zh-CN: 仅可重新运行尚未归档的失败产品工作流。

PRODUCT_WORKFLOW_ALREADY_CURRENT.en-US: This product workflow already uses the latest version.
PRODUCT_WORKFLOW_ALREADY_CURRENT.zh-CN: 当前产品工作流已使用最新版本，无需升级重跑。

PRODUCT_RESTART_REVISION_UNSUPPORTED.en-US: The latest product workflow cannot safely restore this session's inputs. Update the workflow package before retrying.
PRODUCT_RESTART_REVISION_UNSUPPORTED.zh-CN: 最新产品工作流无法安全恢复当前会话输入，请先修复工作流版本后重试。

PRODUCT_RESTART_INPUT_INVALID.en-US: A saved product workspace input is invalid and cannot be restored safely.
PRODUCT_RESTART_INPUT_INVALID.zh-CN: 已保存的产品工作区输入无效，无法安全恢复。

PRODUCT_ARTIFACT_NOT_REVIEWABLE.en-US: This artifact is not reviewable or has changed. Complete its review checks and regenerate the delivery summary before accepting it.
PRODUCT_ARTIFACT_NOT_REVIEWABLE.zh-CN: 当前产物尚不可评审或内容已变化，请完成检查并重新生成交付总结后再接受。

PRODUCT_ARTIFACT_NOT_REGISTERED.en-US: The current artifact has not been registered. Regenerate the delivery summary first.
PRODUCT_ARTIFACT_NOT_REGISTERED.zh-CN: 当前产物尚未登记，请先重新生成交付总结。

PRODUCT_ARTIFACT_CHANGED.en-US: The artifact changed after finalization. You can continue with it as a shared draft, but must finalize the stage again before marking it accepted.
PRODUCT_ARTIFACT_CHANGED.zh-CN: 产物在交付总结后发生了修改；仍可作为共享草稿继续使用，但标记为正式依据前需重新完成本阶段交付总结。

PRODUCT_ARTIFACT_INVALID.en-US: The source artifact is unreadable. Restore it or generate the current stage again.
PRODUCT_ARTIFACT_INVALID.zh-CN: 上游产物无法读取，请恢复文件或重新生成当前阶段产物。

PRODUCT_ARTIFACT_TOO_LARGE.en-US: Stage transitions support individual files up to 20 MB.
PRODUCT_ARTIFACT_TOO_LARGE.zh-CN: 阶段接力支持单个文件不超过 20 MB。

PRODUCT_ARTIFACT_PATH_INVALID.en-US: This artifact file is not registered in the current project's shared workspace, so it cannot be read safely. Refresh the project; if this persists, save the artifact again.
PRODUCT_ARTIFACT_PATH_INVALID.zh-CN: 该产物文件未登记在当前项目的共享工作区，系统无法安全读取。请刷新项目；如仍出现，请重新保存该产物。

STATE_VERSION_CONFLICT.en-US: The workflow changed while this action was being submitted. Refresh and try again.
STATE_VERSION_CONFLICT.zh-CN: 工作流状态在提交期间发生了变化，请刷新后重试。

STEP_NOT_READY.en-US: This step is not ready yet. Refresh the workflow and complete its required inputs first.
STEP_NOT_READY.zh-CN: 当前步骤尚未就绪，请刷新工作流并先补齐所需输入。

STEP_NOT_REACHABLE.en-US: This step is no longer available on the active workflow path. Refresh the workflow.
STEP_NOT_REACHABLE.zh-CN: 当前步骤已不在有效工作流路径中，请刷新工作流。

IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.en-US: This workflow action conflicts with an earlier submission. Refresh and submit it again.
IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.zh-CN: 本次工作流操作与先前提交冲突，请刷新后重新提交。
